BACKGROUND. Each story package keeps scene-entry snapshots in <story_root>/entry/<scene>.json. Any change to the story's source therefore makes every snapshot stale, and about 20 tests in the PR suite then fail. The factory's station 5 (factory/stations/free_gates.py, free_gates_handler) runs the free deterministic gates on a candidate repair tree; nothing in the factory regenerates the snapshots, so every factory story repair would fail CI. 1. Import by name at module level: `from storygame.runtime.entry_snapshots import check_entry_snapshots, write_entry_snapshots` and call them through those module-level names (tests monkeypatch them there).
2. 3. The step is skipped when the payload has `entry_snapshots: false` (the same pattern as `carry_matrix`); default on.
4. When the ticket has its own tree (ticket_tree returned a path) AND the resolved story_root lies inside that tree, call write_entry_snapshots(story_root). When there is no ticket tree, or story_root lies outside it, NEVER write: the station must not modify the main checkout. In every case then call check_entry_snapshots(story_root).
5. If write_entry_snapshots raises (any Exception), or check_entry_snapshots returns any problems, return StationResult(False, "entry_snapshots", <text>), where text is the problems joined by newlines (or the error text), passed through _tail. With no tree, stale snapshots therefore fail with check_entry_snapshots' own 'stale fingerprint for scene ...' lines, which is right: they can only be regenerated in a ticket tree.

import os, sys, time
